entities.name: Extended emergency number list
entities.description: Encodes one or more local emergency numbers together with a sub-services field containing zero or more sub-services of the associated emergency service URN and a validity indication.

entities.name: Emergency service URN
entities.description: A service URN with top level service type of 'sos' as specified in IETF RFC 5031. Can be country-specific as defined in 3GPP TS 24.229.

entities.name: Sub-services field
entities.description: Contains zero or more sub-services of the associated emergency service URN. Characters coded in GSM 7 bit default alphabet.

entities.name: Number digits
entities.description: Encodes the emergency number digits. First digit entered is located in octet 6, bits 1-4. Contents coded as per table 10.5.118/3GPP TS 24.008.

entities.name: End mark
entities.description: Fills bits 5-8 of last octet with '1111' when emergency number contains odd number of digits.

relations.description: The Extended emergency number list IE contains the sub-services field.
The Extended emergency number list IE contains the number digits field.
The sub-services field contains sub-services of the associated emergency service URN.
The number digits field uses end mark when emergency number contains odd number of digits.
